messages.text: I tried to place my preorder for the lotto miner but it says it cannot deliver to my address
Searched the catalog · Harlo L. lotto miner
Searched the catalog · Loto
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Read the mystery miner early access page
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Looked something up in Shopify
Handed to the team · Blocked at checkout by shipping zones; shipping/product settings are not mine to

I checked, and the problem is on our side. The Harlo L. pre-order is only set up to ship to the US, Canada and Europe right now. Australia hasn't been added yet, so checkout won't take your address.

I can't change shipping settings myself, so I've passed it to Georges with your details. He'll get back to you by email at (email hidden) about whether Australian orders can go through. You don't need to send anything again.
So you know, I sent a reply email from the special order email to Abel, asking about it but no reply.  I want the lotto miner and at the $599 price.
Ran comms_history.py (store-orders skill)
Handed to the team · Price he was offered and AU shipping both need Georges/Abel; replaces my earlier

I've sent this to Georges, and he'll reply to (email hidden) I included that you've already emailed Abel about the special order and haven't heard back.

You want the lotto miner at $599 delivered to Australia, and that has two parts:

1. **The price:** I can't confirm $599 from the listing I can see, so Georges has to say whether that offer still stands.
2. **Delivery:** the listing doesn't ship to Australia yet, which is why checkout rejected your address.

You don't need to send anything again.
Okay, I will wait for George’s response. Any updates available on my order for 2 x 40T placed using (email hidden)
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Ran warehouse.py (store-orders skill)

Bernard, your order Shop···· is paid but hasn't shipped yet. It has your two Magic M. 40Ts, two Miner D.s and two Power K.s.

It ships by November 30. All 300 units in the production run were built and left the factory together, and they're now on their way to our warehouse. We'll email your tracking number to (email hidden) as soon as it ships.

You can follow the shipment to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Okay thanks
Used the chat-interview skill

You're welcome, Bernard. Georges has your Harlo L. request and will reply to (email hidden)

Before you go, can I ask one thing? You already have two 40Ts coming, so what made you want the Loto as well?

I needed a smaller miner I can run 24/7, so with the other lotto incentives and it should have the ability to run home assistant, it made sense to get it at the @$599 price, otherwise it was too expensive.

Thanks Bernard, that helps. A small miner you can run 24/7, the Loto incentives, Home Assistant and the $599 price all make sense together. I'll make sure Georges knows that $599 is what makes it worth it for you.

One more question if that's okay: what would you want Home Assistant to do on it? For example, would it control the miner, or would the Loto act as the hub for the rest of your home?
Both

Thanks Bernard, that's useful. I'll make sure Georges knows you want it both to control the miner and to run as your home hub. He'll also cover the $599 price and getting it delivered to Australia when he replies to (email hidden)

Your two 40Ts ship by November 30, and we'll email you tracking as soon as they leave. Have a good one.
Thanks you also
You're welcome, Bernard. Georges will email you about the Loto, and your 40T tracking will come to the same address. Take care.
